card.name: Sports career and league-level phrases
card.fires_on: Mostly small words (the, his, a, in, at) or digits inside sports or history prose, right before a league, season, debut or salon name. Seen in football, baseball and motorsport biographies.

modes.label: Small word before league or season
modes.description: A linking word in sports biography text just before a competition, league or season term.
modes.example: Castleton made<< his>> first regular season appearance in Youngstown's

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a year number, in sports or history text.
modes.example: slick tires were not used from the 19<<9>>8 to 2008 seasons

modes.label: Before a named event or institution
modes.description: A word just before a proper name of a venue, league or exhibition.
modes.example: when the artist made his debut at the 1859<< Paris>> Salon

card.writes: It seems to push toward place or organization names (like Sachs, NRL) and away from team and club words.
card.plain: It fires on small words in sports and history writing that come just before a league, season or event name.
